name: Tsukimori Rin
source:
Rin is a third-year student at Saika Girls' Academy and the daughter of the school's headmaster. She has a playful personality, a passion for cute things, a keen sense of smell, and a deep knowledge of perfumes and aromas. She enjoys soaking in the natural scent of hot springs at the inn where Sora stays.

Rin holds the position of student council president but doesn't take her role too seriously. Despite this, she is a dependable and trusted figure for her peers during difficult times.

Rin often skips classes and falls asleep in the infirmary. She has been dealing with nightmares recently but hides her troubles and puts on a brave face for Sora.

"Cute, cute, cute! Take-home material!"
"Just call me 'Tsukimorin' as a cute nickname, okay♪."
"You have a talent for being naughty, don't you, Sensei?"

[Translated from the [url=https://citrus-soft.net/product/hokecho/character.html]official website[/url]]
